subtasks.name: L1-pink-on-blue
subtasks.prompt: put the pink cube on top of a blue cube
subtasks.check: Is the pink cube (with a hole) resting on top of a blue cube, not on the table?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers and show the tower from the side.

subtasks.name: L2-pink-stick-up
subtasks.prompt: stand the pink stick upright in the hole of the pink cube
subtasks.check: Is the pink stick standing upright in the hole of the pink cube that sits on a blue cube?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers and show the tower from the side.

subtasks.name: L3-blue-on-stick
subtasks.prompt: put the other blue cube on top of the pink stick
subtasks.check: Is a blue cube resting on top of the upright pink stick, with the stick going into the blue cube's hole?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers and show the tower from the side.

subtasks.name: L4-yellow-stick-up
subtasks.prompt: stand the yellow stick upright in the hole of the top blue cube
subtasks.check: Is the yellow stick standing upright in the hole of the blue cube at the top of the tower?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers and show the tower from the side.
